Trust decision: whether a stored cookie may be sent to a subdomain spelling-variant of its Domain is decided in `SetCookie::matchesDomain()`, which must keep percent-escaped and inet_aton-numeric (dec/oct/hex) cookie domains exact-match-only.
`pattern_fit`: A — the fix spans `src/Cookie/SetCookie.php` plus a new lower-level `HostValidator::isNumericIpv4Host()` in the Handler package, with several input shapes and real must-keep-working values next to the sink.
Strongest lever: the coupled HOW-type value next to the hidden one — hex/octal cookie domains must go exact-only while `svc.0xdeadbeef` and a percent-bearing *request* host (`%65vil.example.com`) must keep suffix-matching, so a percent-only fix misses and an over-broad one breaks.
Biggest red flag: `tiny_repo` (~1.5 MB of PHP); the deeper weakness is that all three entry points converge on one centralized check, so O8 room is empty and Pattern B does not apply.
